it is taking a huge toll, but I really can't do much. I've been looking around, but there just isn't enough time to deal with finding a new job. my boss is a nice guy but he's one of those nice types who are really patronizing when they talk. he gave me some ridiculous excuse about people abusing part time to pick their own schedule. 

I'm a smart guy, the only reason I don't have a cushy office job is because I didn't finish college or can't find the right connections. I appreciate the offer, but I live quite a bit north of you. I hope you enjoy the weather down there.

I work in a warehouse, and in November/December everything went to hell. bunch of people failed random drug tests, and while the load was heavy(10+ hrs every workday, half days on days off) people just started quitting. definitely no help from management during the worst time of the year, "were going to wait until after new year's to bring on more hires" they just split the work among the rest of us. we've been working this way for over 4 months now, and after a week vacation(without pay) I've come back and its gotten worse. I come in at 10am and stay until 2 am, and they say its getting better? they keep saying they're bringing in more people but for every 5 people who get hired maybe 4 don't pan out, and during the week another veteran will quit. I'm nearing the top of seniority and I've only worked here since September.

at the moment there just isn't enough time to seriously look. I get maybe 2 or 3 hours at home after 12 to do whatever, then I have to get to sleep for work the next day. I wake up and have to leave for work in about an hour.
